name: 28990-longdecode-deepseekv2lite16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bounded at 320 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 1024 (min = max on both), greedy; ignore_eos is forced, so all 1024 output tokens are always generated.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating full-page answers from page-length prompts for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's arguments. The engine itself is the source checkout named by
# `configs/env.yaml: venv`; interpreter and hardware live in that file.
#
# CAUTION, flat reader: any line starting with a space is skipped, so every key must be
# top-level and every value must fit on one line.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Required, not decorative: `deepseek_v2` is not a model_type the pinned transformers knows,
# so AutoConfig cannot load this repo's config without it.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
async-scheduling: true
max-model-len: 8192

# Pinned rather than left out: an engine built in-process resolves a context that is in no
# default table and falls through to 2048, which chunks a 1024-token prefill differently from
# a served deployment. 8192 is the served-context value.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
